I’ll check how trace deletion parses IDs, add whitespace trimming and a regression test, then run the relevant tests. I’m using the repository’s Python style skill.
Updated trace deletion to strip whitespace around each comma-separated ID, so `"a, b"` works like `"a,b"`.

Expanded regression coverage for spaces, tabs, and newlines, verifying the IDs passed to deletion.

All 11 tests in `tests/cli/test_traces.py` passed. Pytest then exited with a sandbox permission error in its process-inspection cleanup hook. No dependencies were installed.
